text: Pick up Aziz's phone and look at it.
prefix: Pick up Aziz's phone and look at it.

text: It is glass, a chip and a SIM card, and a million other phones look the same.
prefix: It is glass, a chip and a SIM card, and a million other phones look the same.

text: So how does the platform know that this phone is Aziz's?
prefix: So how does the platform know that this phone is Aziz's?

text: In Lesson 19, the platform linked Aziz to the bank's own customer records.
prefix: In Lesson 19, the platform linked Aziz to the bank's own customer records.

text: This lesson looks at the thing in his hand: the device record, its states, the check at each request, and the app PIN.
prefix: This lesson looks at the thing in his hand: the device record, its states, the check at each request, and the app PIN.

text: Go back to the day Aziz registered in the mobile bank.
prefix: Go back to the day Aziz registered in the mobile bank.

text: When his account was made, the platform also made a record for his phone.
prefix: When his account was made, the platform also made a record for his phone.

text: It gave the phone a random identifier.
prefix: It gave the phone a random identifier.

text: The app keeps this identifier and sends it with every request.
prefix: The app keeps this identifier and sends it with every request.

text: The identifier is never made from the serial number or any other hardware value.
prefix: The identifier is never made from the serial number or any other hardware value.

text: It is random, so it tells nobody anything about the phone.
prefix: It is random, so it tells nobody anything about the phone.

text: Now look inside the record.
prefix: Now look inside the record.

text: It keeps the customer reference.
prefix: It keeps the customer reference.

text: It keeps Aziz's personal identification number, in a form that cannot be reversed.
prefix: It keeps Aziz's personal identification number, in a form that cannot be reversed.

text: It keeps the platform, the model, the version of the system and the version of the app.
prefix: It keeps the platform, the model, the version of the system and the version of the app.

text: It keeps the time the record was made, and the time the phone was last seen.
prefix: It keeps the time the record was made, and the time the phone was last seen.

text: And it keeps a state.
prefix: And it keeps a state.

text: One identifier belongs to one customer for its whole life.
prefix: One identifier belongs to one customer for its whole life.

text: It never moves to a second person.
prefix: It never moves to a second person.

text: On registration day, Aziz was at level one.
prefix: On registration day, Aziz was at level one.

text: So his phone got the state Known, not Trusted.
prefix: So his phone got the state Known, not Trusted.

text: Known means that the platform has seen this phone with this customer before.
prefix: Known means that the platform has seen this phone with this customer before.

text: It says nothing about the person.
prefix: It says nothing about the person.

text: A week later, Aziz passed MyID on this same phone, and his status became Confirmed.
prefix: A week later, Aziz passed MyID on this same phone, and his status became Confirmed.

text: At that moment the record changed: the phone became Trusted.
prefix: At that moment the record changed: the phone became Trusted.

text: Only a MyID check that ends with Confirmed makes a device trusted.
prefix: Only a MyID check that ends with Confirmed makes a device trusted.

text: No code and no password can do it.
prefix: No code and no password can do it.

text: Next, the app PIN.
prefix: Next, the app PIN.

text: After the first login on a phone, the app asks Aziz to set an app PIN.
prefix: After the first login on a phone, the app asks Aziz to set an app PIN.

text: The app is not usable until he does.
prefix: The app is not usable until he does.

text: The length is a policy of the bank.
prefix: The length is a policy of the bank.

text: The app refuses easy PINs, like a simple run of digits, or one digit again and again.
prefix: The app refuses easy PINs, like a simple run of digits, or one digit again and again.

text: Here is the part I like most.
prefix: Here is the part I like most.

text: The PIN never leaves the phone.
prefix: The PIN never leaves the phone.

text: The platform records only that a PIN was set, when, and on which device.
prefix: The platform records only that a PIN was set, when, and on which device.

text: Only the phone checks the PIN.
prefix: Only the phone checks the PIN.

text: The platform never accepts a PIN as proof of anything.
prefix: The platform never accepts a PIN as proof of anything.

text: And the PIN is not the password: the password opens a login, the PIN only unlocks the app on this phone.
prefix: And the PIN is not the password: the password opens a login, the PIN only unlocks the app on this phone.

text: I think this split is honest.
prefix: I think this split is honest.

text: A short PIN is good for the hand, and weak for a server, so the server never trusts it.
prefix: A short PIN is good for the hand, and weak for a server, so the server never trusts it.

text: Now the threat.
prefix: Now the threat.

text: A stranger gets hold of Aziz's phone for a few minutes.
prefix: A stranger gets hold of Aziz's phone for a few minutes.

text: He copies the app's tokens and puts them in the app on his own phone.
prefix: He copies the app's tokens and puts them in the app on his own phone.

text: His app sends a request with the copied tokens, and with its own device identifier.
prefix: His app sends a request with the copied tokens, and with its own device identifier.

text: This is where the binding check works.
prefix: This is where the binding check works.

text: At each request, the customer gateway asks three questions.
prefix: At each request, the customer gateway asks three questions.

text: First, is this device Trusted or Known?
prefix: First, is this device Trusted or Known?

text: Second, does this device belong to the customer of this request?
prefix: Second, does this device belong to the customer of this request?

text: Third, is the personal identification number bound to this device the same as the customer's number?
prefix: Third, is the personal identification number bound to this device the same as the customer's number?

text: The stranger's phone fails the second question.
prefix: The stranger's phone fails the second question.

text: It is not Aziz's device.
prefix: It is not Aziz's device.

text: One no is enough.
prefix: One no is enough.

text: The access grant ends at once.
prefix: The access grant ends at once.

text: The device becomes Revoked, with the reason binding mismatch.
prefix: The device becomes Revoked, with the reason binding mismatch.

text: The platform writes a security event, and the app must start a new login.
prefix: The platform writes a security event, and the app must start a new login.

text: A revoked device stays revoked.
prefix: A revoked device stays revoked.

text: It never becomes trusted again.
prefix: It never becomes trusted again.

text: If someone logs in again on that same phone, the platform makes a new record, which starts from the beginning.
prefix: If someone logs in again on that same phone, the platform makes a new record, which starts from the beginning.

text: An operator of the bank can also revoke one device, or all the devices of a customer, with a reason.
prefix: An operator of the bank can also revoke one device, or all the devices of a customer, with a reason.

text: The grant of a revoked device ends at its next request, not later.
prefix: The grant of a revoked device ends at its next request, not later.

text: So the check runs on every request, not once a day.
prefix: So the check runs on every request, not once a day.

text: To recap: a random identifier, three states, one check at each request, and a PIN that never leaves the phone.
prefix: To recap: a random identifier, three states, one check at each request, and a PIN that never leaves the phone.

text: Known means seen before.
prefix: Known means seen before.

text: Trusted means MyID passed on this device.
prefix: Trusted means MyID passed on this device.

text: Revoked is final.
prefix: Revoked is final.

text: But the binding check needs something to check.
prefix: But the binding check needs something to check.

text: At each request, the app shows the gateway more than an identifier.
prefix: At each request, the app shows the gateway more than an identifier.

text: What does the app actually hold to call the platform?
prefix: What does the app actually hold to call the platform?
